peft.standalone: Adapter eno eya LoRA / PEFT yeetaaga model yaayo eya base enzijuvu. Yingiza base era osseeko adapter mu Safetensors provider; adapter size yokka si ye memory eyeetaagisa okugiddukanya.
peft.description: Londa model ya base enzijuvu waggulu, olwo folda yaayo eya adapter. Adapter yokka si model enzijuvu. Base identity erina okukwatagana n'ensengeka ya adapter.
peft.estimate: Okubalirira kwa CPU okukuuma ku 2,048 tokens. Eddamu okubalirirwa ku kyuma ekirondeddwa n'embeera mu kiseera ky'okutikka. Module ezigendererwamu n’ebifaananyi bya tenso bikeberebwa mu kiseera ky’okutikka.

noInstalledModels: Tewali models ewandiisiddwa mu kiti kino.
limitedSupport: Omuwabuzi ono ayinza obutawagirwa mu bujjuvu. Obusobozi (ebikozesebwa, okulaba, amaloboozi) tebuzuulibwa mu ngeri ya auto-detected - yongera ku models mu ngalo era osengeke obusobozi buli model.
mlxExperimental: Obuwagizi bwa MLX bwa kugezesa. Embeddings teziriwo, reasoning toggle tennaba kuyita mu waya, era ezimu ku model architectures empya ziyinza okulemererwa okutikka. Loopa ensonga ku GitHub tusobole okuzikulembeza.
engineBundled: Yingini ya inference ezimbiddwa mu Novera, kale tewali kintu kya kuwanula oba kulongoosa mu ngeri ya njawulo. Quote this version nga oloopa model eremereddwa okutikka.
engineOtherVersion: Oyagala enkyusa ya llama.cpp ey'enjawulo? Dukanya llama-server yo era ogigattako nga custom OpenAI-compatible provider.
refreshModelsError: Omuwa alina okuba ne base URL ne waakiri ekisumuluzo kya API kimu ekitegekeddwa okuleeta models.
noNewModels: Tewali bika bipya bizuuliddwa. Ebika byonna ebiriwo byayongerwako dda.
refreshModelsFailed: Eremereddwa okuleeta ebikozesebwa okuva mu {{provider}}. Nsaba okebere ekisumuluzo kyo ekya API ne URL ya base.
backendHistoryEmpty: Tewali bipya bya backend biwandiikiddwa n'okutuusa kati.
embeddingModelsDesc: Ekozesebwa mu kunoonya kwa RAG ne vector. Omuze ogulondeddwa gufuuka ogusookerwako nga okola embeddings.
importedTooltip: Eyingiziddwa okuva mu fayiro y'omu kitundu. Okugiggya mu Novera tekijja kusazaamu fayiro eri ku disiki.
noModelFoundDesc: Ebika ebiriwo bijja kuwandiikibwa wano. Bw’oba ​​tonnaba kufuna model yonna, genda ku Hub ogiwanule.
noModelFoundRemoteDesc: Ebika ebiriwo bijja kuwandiikibwa wano. Kozesa button ya refresh waggulu okuleeta models okuva mu provider, oba yongerako emu mu ngalo ne button +.

addModel.title: Yongera ku Model Omupya
addModel.modelExistsDesc: Nsaba olonde ID ya model ey'enjawulo.

deleteModel.choiceDescription: Londa engeri gy'oyinza okuggya model eno mu Novera.
deleteModel.keepFilesDescription: Ggyawo model ku lukalala era oteeke fayiro zaayo ku disiki. Osobola okuddamu okugiyingiza.
deleteModel.permanentDescription: Ssaawo model ne fayiro zaayo eziddukanyizibwa Novera okuva ku disiki. Kino tekiyinza kuggyibwawo.
deleteModel.permanentImportedDescription: Era sazaamu fayiro ya GGUF enkulu mu kifo kyayo ekyasooka. Fayiro ez’obuyambi ez’ebweru zikuumibwa. Kino tekiyinza kuggyibwawo.
deleteModel.removedSuccess: Omuze {{modelId}} gwaggyibwa mu Novera. Fayiro zaayo zaakuumibwa.
deleteModel.title: Okusazaamu Omuze: {{modelId}}
deleteModel.description: Okakasa nti oyagala kusazaamu model eno? Ekikolwa kino tekiyinza kuddibwamu.
deleteModel.importedDescription: Ggyawo model eno eyayingizibwa mu Novera? Fayiro yo eya wano ku disiki tejja kusazibwamu.

deleteAllModels.title: Okusazaamu models zonna eziwanuliddwa?
deleteAllModels.description: Kino kijja kuggyawo enkalakkalira {{count}} model(s) okuva ku disiki.
deleteAllModels.importedExcluded: {{count}} model(s) eziyingiziddwa zijja kukuumibwa (fayiro zaabwe tezawanulibwa Novera).
deleteAllModels.partialFailure: Eremereddwa okusazaamu {{count}} model(s). Laba console okumanya ebisingawo.

deleteProvider.title: Okusazaamu Omuwa
deleteProvider.description: Ssaako omugabi ono ne model zaayo zonna. Ekikolwa kino tekiyinza kuddibwamu.
deleteProvider.confirmDescription: Okakasa nti oyagala kusazaamu provider ono? Ekikolwa kino tekiyinza kuddibwamu.

editModel.title: Okulongoosa Omuze: {{modelId}}
editModel.description: Tegeka obusobozi bwa model nga okyusakyusa ebyokulonda wansi.

warning.title: Genda mu maaso n'obwegendereza
warning.description: Okukyusa obusobozi bw’ekyokulabirako kiyinza okukosa omulimu n’enkola. Ensengeka enkyamu ziyinza okuleeta enneeyisa oba ensobi ezitasuubirwa.

baseUrl.title: URL y’omusingi
baseUrl.azureDescription: Enkomerero yo eya Azure OpenAI. Kikyuseemu YOUR-RESOURCE-NAME n'erinnya lyo ery'ekintu kya Azure.
baseUrl.alibabaDescription: Kozesa enkomerero y'ekifo kyo eky'okukoleramu n'ekitundu kyo ekya Alibaba Cloud. Kikyuseemu YOUR-WORKSPACE-ID ne ID yo ey'ekifo ky'okolera era okozese ekisumuluzo kya API okuva mu kitundu kye kimu.

apiKeys.title: Ebisumuluzo bya API
apiKeys.description: Yingiza ekisumuluzo kyo ekya API. Osobola okwongera ebisumuluzo eby’enjawulo mu Advanced, era Novera ejja kugezaako ekiddako mu ngeri ey’otoma singa ekisumuluzo kiremererwa.
apiKeys.testHint: Akebera /models ne buli kisumuluzo era eraga embeera ya buli kisumuluzo.
apiKeys.oneKeyHint: Ebisumuluzo bya fallback eby’okwesalirawo bitegekeddwa mu Advanced.
